messages.content:
You formalize German traffic rules as temporal-logic formulae over the physical state of the world.

OUTPUT FORMAT: exactly one YAML document (no surrounding prose, no code fences) with keys: rule_id, description, sampling_rate_hz, horizon, constants, environment (signals with name/sort), formula.

FORMULA LANGUAGE (strict fragment — anything else is rejected):
- outermost operator must be G( ... )
- Boolean: and, or, not, ->
- temporal: F[a,b](...), H[a,b](...), O[a,b](...) with integer step bounds
- atoms: linear comparisons (<=, >=, <, >) over declared signals, declared
  constants, numbers, abs(...); NO signal*signal products, NO nested G,
  NO unbounded operators.
- bare boolean signals are atoms.

Declare every quantity you use (true gap, true velocity, hazard-light
state, ...) as an environment signal; name numeric parameters as constants.
The formula ranges over the state of the world, not over any software
architecture.

EXAMPLE (synthetic watchdog rule -- study the exact YAML shape):
rule_id: SYN_watchdog_flat
description: A warning shall follow a sustained runaway torque command.
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 8
constants:
  T_MAX: 3.0
environment:
  signals:
    - {name: torque_cmd, sort: real}
    - {name: warn, sort: bool}
formula: "G((torque_cmd >= T_MAX) -> F[0,3](warn))"

Formalize the following rule as a single formula document.
Rule: Safe distance to the preceding vehicle (StVO §4(1)): 'Der Abstand zu einem vorausfahrenden Fahrzeug muss in der Regel so groß sein, dass auch dann hinter ihm gehalten werden kann, wenn es plötzlich gebremst wird.' Use the time-gap interpretation: whenever the true gap to the preceding vehicle falls below 1.8 s times the true ego velocity, a hazard notification must be raised within 300 ms (3 steps at 10 Hz).
Context: Perception estimates the gap with a bounded error of 2.0 m; Localization estimates the ego velocity with a bounded error of 0.5 m/s.
Use rule_id: R_G1_flat. Output only the YAML document.

rule_id: R_G1_flat
description: Safe distance to the preceding vehicle (StVO §4(1)) – time-gap interpretation with hazard notification
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 3
constants:
  MIN_GAP_S: 1.8
  MAX_GAP_ERROR_M: 2.0
  MAX_VEL_ERROR_MPS: 0.5
  NOTIFICATION_DEADLINE_STEPS: 3
environment:
  signals:
    - {name: true_gap, sort: real}
    - {name: true_ego_velocity, sort: real}
    - {name: perceived_gap, sort: real}
    - {name: perceived_velocity, sort: real}
    - {name: hazard_notification, sort: bool}
formula: "G(((true_gap < (MIN_GAP_S * true_ego_velocity)) and (abs(perceived_gap - true_gap) <= MAX_GAP_ERROR_M) and (abs(perceived_velocity - true_ego_velocity) <= MAX_VEL_ERROR_MPS)) -> F[0,NOTIFICATION_DEADLINE_STEPS](hazard_notification))"

Your rule document was rejected by the formal checker. Fix the document and output the complete corrected YAML document (again: YAML only). Checker errors:
- [CRASH] baseline checker raised ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: 'NOTIFICATION_DEADLINE_STEPS'

content:
rule_id: R_G1_flat
description: Safe distance to the preceding vehicle (StVO §4(1)) – time-gap interpretation with hazard notification
sampling_rate_hz: 10
horizon: 3
constants:
  MIN_GAP_S: 1.8
  MAX_GAP_ERROR_M: 2.0
  MAX_VEL_ERROR_MPS: 0.5
environment:
  signals:
    - {name: true_gap, sort: real}
    - {name: true_ego_velocity, sort: real}
    - {name: hazard_notification, sort: bool}
formula: "G((true_gap < (MIN_GAP_S * true_ego_velocity)) -> F[0,3](hazard_notification))"
